# wait.command

Wait for a shell command to exit with the expected code

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `cmd` | string | **Yes** | - |
| `expect_exit` | integer | No | - |
| `interval` | string | No | - |
| `poll_interval` | string | No | - |
| `timeout` | string | No | - |

## Platform Support

linux, darwin, windows, freebsd
